📰 General

Fantasy Football Preview: Key RBs Target Big Games in Week 17 Predictions •

Ahead of Week 17 fantasy football matchups, several running backs are generating significant attention. James Cook is anticipated to be a focal point for teams facing the Philadelphia Eagles, aiming to leverage his offensive role. Derrick Henry is scheduled to play at Lambeau Field, seeking to capitalize on the favorable conditions. Ashton Jeanty is looking to build upon a recent surge in performance, hoping to contribute substantially to his team’s success.

🌍 World

Kenyan Residents Protest Deadly Elephant Attacks, Blaming Habitat Loss •

Protests erupted in Kenya following a week of attacks by roaming elephants that resulted in the deaths of four individuals. Experts attribute the increased aggression to a severe lack of vegetation due to drought conditions. One elephant is believed to be responsible for two fatalities, highlighting the escalating human-wildlife conflict. Authorities are struggling to manage the animals and prevent further casualties. The situation underscores the challenges of conservation in a region facing environmental pressures.

🦅 US

Mortgage Rates Edge Down Slightly, Holding Steady at 6.18% •

The average rate for a 30-year U.S. mortgage decreased marginally this week, settling at 6.18%. This represents a continuation of a trend observed over the past two months, maintaining a consistent rate range. Freddie Mac’s latest data indicates a small decline from the previous week’s 6.21% average. Experts attribute the slight decrease to a combination of factors including a cooling housing market and shifting investor sentiment. The rate remains elevated compared to recent years.

💰 Business

Gen Z Remains Cautiously Optimistic About Cryptocurrency Investments •

A segment of Generation Z retains interest in cryptocurrency, recalling the 2021 market surge and initial investment attempts. Wyatt Johnson invested approximately $5,000 in cryptocurrency during that period, anticipating significant returns. However, his experience, like many others, did not result in substantial profits. This reflects a cautious approach to crypto among younger investors who recognize the volatility of the market.

💻 Technology

Windows 11 NVMe SSD Performance Soars with New Native Driver Release •

A newly released native NVMe driver for Windows 11 is significantly boosting the performance of NVMe SSDs. Testing conducted using the driver from Windows Server 2025 revealed double-digit gains in random read and write speeds. This improvement is attributed to the driver’s direct access to the SSD’s capabilities, bypassing limitations of previous implementations. The update promises a noticeable upgrade for users relying on NVMe storage for demanding applications and tasks.

🎭 Entertainment

Bowen Yang’s SNL Farewell Drives Highest Ratings in Over a Year •

Saturday Night Live’s December 20th episode garnered 5.4 million viewers, marking the show’s most-watched installment in more than a year. The episode featured pop star Ariana Grande as host and Cher as the musical guest. This viewership surge coincided with Bowen Yang’s final appearance on the sketch comedy series. The episode’s success demonstrates continued interest in “Saturday Night Live” despite recent shifts in its cast.

🏅 Sports

Commanders Name Josh Johnson Starting QB for Christmas Day Game vs. Cowboys •

The Washington Commanders have designated Josh Johnson as their starting quarterback for their matchup against the Dallas Cowboys on Thursday, December 26th. This marks Johnson’s 10th career NFL start, with his previous one occurring in Week 9 of the 2021 season. Marcus Mariota is ruled out due to a reported quad injury, necessitating Johnson’s return to the starting role. The Commanders are currently without a stable quarterback situation following injuries to their primary options.

🔬 Science

Goblin Shark’s Record-Breaking Bite Reveals Stunning Ambush Tactics in Deep Ocean •

Scientists have recently studied the goblin shark (Mitsukurina owstoni), revealing a remarkably fast bite – the fastest ever recorded among sharks. The research, based on analysis of a specimen recovered from the Pacific Ocean, highlights the shark’s unique predatory strategy. The goblin shark possesses a highly protrusible jaw, extending forward to capture prey with incredible speed. This ambush technique, combined with its elongated, cartilaginous snout, makes it a highly effective predator in the deep-sea environment.

🩺 Health

ADHD Medications’ Effects Challenged: New Research Reveals Unexpected Mechanisms •

Recent research published in Psych Post challenges long-held assumptions about how common ADHD medications work. Scientists have discovered that stimulants, such as methylphenidate, primarily affect the brain’s reward system rather than directly targeting the prefrontal cortex as previously believed. The study utilized advanced brain imaging techniques to observe changes in activity within the ventral striatum, a key area involved in motivation and reward processing. This finding suggests a more complex mechanism of action for these widely prescribed drugs.
